notes: Row-context regression fixture (verify@v2/v3, W2 verifier-row-context).
The page mirrors the real Tamil Nadu AHS UG seat-matrix page 1: the same
programme label and the same number print on several institutions' rows,
so a label+value quote is ambiguous without the row context.
s01 is the real Stanley claim: quote '3. B.Sc. Medical Laboratory
Technology\n20' resolved by context_row to the Stanley block (column
'Intake'). verify@v1 judged it wrong_field because its prompt assumed a
quote is only the value; v2 judges the row/column association and accepts
it - the false rejection that wave fixed. The W2 seat-semantics split
renamed its predicate to seats.intake: the quote is ONE programme row's
sanctioned intake, not an aggregate.
s02 is the counterfactual: the SAME quote asserted as seats.total against
the Chengalpattu block, whose MLT row is '1.' not '3.'. It fails twice
over - wrong row, and a row value presented under the aggregate predicate
(seats.total is only for a total the document itself states). The value 20
is printed in the window but the claim must stay wrong_field even after
the repair pass. This is the anti-regression: the seat split did not
relax the wrong-row rule to make a fixture pass.
s03 quotes a bare amount with neither a currency nor a period printed
anywhere: a money+period claim the page never states. It must be rejected
(absent, no repair), mirroring the extractor's missing_period guard.
s04 is a bare-value quote ('20 seats') from a prose line with no row
context, predicate seats.intake: it verifies exactly as it did under v1.

claims.context: Govt. Stanley Medical College & Hospital, Chennai - 600 001
